# Vendored markdown-reflow

Copied from the standalone `markdown-reflow` repository, version `0.3.0`,
commit `dccd8df19c144ab97fd929159902a3b15a6221c6`.
The source checkout used for this import was `../markdown-reflow`.

`Cargo.toml`, `src/`, and `EXAMPLE.md` are copied without modifications.
The Obsidian plugin, build artifacts, and standalone lockfile are excluded.
This workspace uses its root `Cargo.lock`.

To update, copy these files from a reviewed upstream revision, update this
record, and use `cargo add -p leanck-normalize markdown-reflow --path
vendor/markdown-reflow` to refresh the dependency. Run the normalizer and
markdown-reflow tests before committing.
